title: clingen index regeneration pipeline parameters
description: Regenerates the ClinGen CA-ID index (caid.fst + manifest.json) from Registry region enumeration, ClinVar and optionally gnomAD, and proves every key reachable before publishing.

input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: What to regenerate, and from which sources.

chrom.description: Chromosome: 1-22, X, Y, MT (a chr prefix is accepted, and chrM) or all.
chrom.help_text: Narrows every source: windows, ClinVar, gnomAD, the genome and the index. A bare number reaches validation as an integer, hence the integer range.
chrom.errorMessage: Use 1-22, X, Y, MT (a chr prefix is accepted, and chrM) or all.

regions.description: Region set to enumerate: cds, pc_exons, exons, genes, or a BED file.
regions.help_text: The sets are cut from the UCSC ncbiRefSeq and knownGene tables (RefSeq and GENCODE): cds = coding sequence, pc_exons = whole exons of coding transcripts, exons = all exons, genes = whole transcripts.

datasets.description: Comma-separated datasets whose sites are looked up: clinvar, gnomad_genomes, gnomad_exomes.

gnomad_version.description: gnomAD release: latest, or a version such as 4.1.1.
gnomad_version.help_text: MT always uses v3.1's chrM file, as gnomAD v4 has no chrM.

gnomad_mirror.description: Where gnomAD is streamed from: gcs, or aws (AWS Open Data, us-east-1). The md5s always come from GCS.

clinvar_vcf.description: latest (NCBI's weekly clinvar.vcf.gz), or a local clinvar.vcf.gz, with its .md5 beside it, for an exact rerun.

genome.description: Prebuilt vareffect genome (GRCh38.bin, with its .idx beside it); built from UCSC hg38.fa.gz when not given.

cache.description: Comma-separated earlier harvest directories; their registered answers are reused instead of asked again.

window_options.title: Window options
window_options.description: How the region set is cut into Registry query windows.

pad.description: Bases added to both ends of each region.

merge_gap.description: Regions no further apart than this are merged into one window.

max_window.description: Longest window core; a longer merged region is cut into equal parts.

flank.description: Bases added to both ends of a window's core when querying, so alleles crossing its edge are returned.

task_options.title: Task sizes
task_options.description: How much work each task does.

batch_size.description: Sites looked up by one task.

page_size.description: Alleles asked for per Registry request; a window answered this full is split in two and asked again.

split_overlap.description: Bases each half of a split window reaches past the split point.

outdir.description: Local path or s3:// URI for the results.
outdir.help_text: A plain string: an s3:// URI is not probed while the parameters are checked.

allow_mismatches.description: Publish the index even when validate or reach fails.

infrastructure_options.title: Infrastructure options
infrastructure_options.description: Where tasks run; read by the local, slurm and awsbatch profiles.

container.help_text: slurm: a registry name is pulled as docker://<name>; an absolute path is used as an Apptainer image file. awsbatch: the image in ECR.

network_queue.description: SLURM partition for downloads and Registry calls (the network label), if not --slurm_queue.

aws_queue.description: AWS Batch job queue (name or ARN).

aws_region.description: AWS region of the Batch queue and the S3 bucket.

gnomad_listing_url.description: GCS JSON API listing of the gnomAD bucket (object names, sizes and md5s).

ucsc_base.description: UCSC hg38 download directory (transcript tables and hg38.fa.gz).

help.description: Show this help; give a parameter name for its detailed help.

helpFull.description: Show the help with every parameter's details.

showHidden.description: Include hidden parameters in the help.
